description_en: Queries the number of queries per second for one or more accelerated domain names
description_zh: 调用DescribeDomainRealTimeQpsData查询加速域名每秒访问次数数据
name: DescribeDomainRealTimeQpsData

parameters.help_en:
The accelerated domain name. Separate multiple accelerated domain names with commas (,).

You can specify up to 500 domain names in each request
parameters.help_zh:
加速域名，多个域名用半角逗号（,）分隔。

一次最多可以传500个域名
parameters.name: domain_name

parameters.help_en:
The name of the Internet service provider (ISP).

If you do not set this parameter, data of all ISPs is queried. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91077.html operation to query ISP names
parameters.help_zh:
运营商英文名。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91077.html接口获取，不传该参数默认查询所有运营商
parameters.name: isp_name_en

parameters.help_en:
The name of the region.

If you do not set this parameter, data in all regions is queried. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91077.html operation to query regions
parameters.help_zh:
地域英文名。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91077.html接口获取，不传该参数默认查询所有地域
parameters.name: location_name_en

parameters.help_en:
The beginning of the time range to query.

Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh:
获取数据的起始时间。

日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end of the time range to query.

Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

The end time must be later than the start time
parameters.help_zh:
获取数据的结束时间。

日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。

结束时间需大于起始时间
parameters.name: end_time
